item.title: Jacqueline and Jonathan - The Clear Water Bay Golf Club Wedding - Billy ONAIR Photography
item.description: There’s something truly magical about outdoor weddings, and Jacqueline and Jonathan's ceremony at Clear Water Bay Golf Club was no exception. Picture this: the sun shining down just enough to give everything that perfect golden hue, the gentle rustling of leaves in the background, and a stunning view of the water just beyond the lush greens. It was the kind of setting that felt like it was plucked right out of a fairytale.
